Listed max vehicle length runs 33 ft (A06) to 100+ ft, most 54-90 ft. One wheeled unit and one tent per site, 10 people maximum.

note: USACE campground on Clearwater Lake at the end of Highway AA northwest of Piedmont, with four loops: loop C sits on an open grassy point above the lake with views across it; loops A, B and D are wooded. Boat ramp, marina nearby and a day-use swimming beach. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from rec.gov: 57 bookable sites (A/B/C/D), 50-amp in B and C, 30-amp in A, water at 34 sites, no sewer listed; $14 nonelectric / $16 electric peak; reservable May 15 - Sept 14, FCFS outside peak (fcfs 'after_cutoff' cleared; booking.season written). Lakeview confirmed from loop C (open mown grass ~120-140 m to the shore); other loops wooded. Phone and pin flagged.
flags: PHONE (apply.py doesn't write it; entry has none): recreation.gov facility_phone '573-223-7777 (CLEARWATER PROJECT OFFICE)  573-223-4459 (BLUFF VIEW GATEHOUSE)' - suggest 573-223-4459 (campground gatehouse), or 573-223-7777.

PIN: stored 37.1819,-90.7894 is the RIDB facility point; it lands ~25 m south of D07 at the bottom of nonelectric loop D, beside the entrance road. Suggest moving to the loop junction between B and C, ~37.1840,-90.7900, or to loop C (~37.1837,-90.7918).

WATERFRONT (lakeview kept): loop C (19 sites) is on an open mown point; C06-C09 are ~120-140 m from the lake's east shore across open grass and the perimeter road, C16-C19 ~130 m from the north shore; DEM 160 m vs normal pool ~150 m. Open sightline from the loop itself = lakeview. Not lakefront (road + 100 m+ of grass). Loops A, B and D are in woods 250 m+ from water. The swimming beach to the south is day use.

SEASON: not written. The campground runs FCFS outside the May 15 - Sept 14 reservation season (rec.gov notice), but nothing on rec.gov says whether it closes in winter (the availability calendar has no records Nov-Apr). The USACE Little Rock District page returned 403 with no Wayback copy.

FEES: the stored $14-16 matched; the 2024 table's peak began 04-01, 2025-2028 begin 05-15. A third electric code ('STANDARD ELECTRIC u20...') is priced $20 with no matching site type in the catalog; ignored. rec.gov rules carry a militaryDiscount flag; not written.

SITES: count 60 -> 57 (catalog's bookable overnight sites; the 60 came from the description). GA1 (50-amp, not bookable, no coordinates) is likely the gate attendant's pad and is excluded. Largest Max Vehicle Length values (105-210 ft) look like data artifacts; no max_rig_ft written.
Note rewritten: 'on a bluff above the lake' dropped (loop C is on a low grassy point ~10 m above the lake); site/hookup/booking facts now in fields.
